name: Forno Custodia 24” 10.3 Cu. Ft. White Counter Depth Bottom Freezer Refrigerator with Ice Maker and Antique Brass Handle
shortDescription: Optimize your space with the Custodia 24-inch Left-Hinge Refrigerator. the ideal fit for kitchen layouts requiring a left-side door swing. Designed with a space-saving profile and a slim 24-inch width, this unit is perfectly sized for modern urban living without sacrificing storage. It features a 10.3 cu. ft. total capacity and an integrated automatic ice maker, providing constant, fresh ice for your daily refreshments. Powered by Total No Frost technology, it ensures a maintenance-free interior with no manual defrosting required. Maximize your organization with 4 glass shelves, 3 door bins, and a dedicated crisper, alongside 3 clear freezer drawers. Manage your settings via a sleek touch interface with Fast Cool, Fast Freeze, and advanced utility modes like Sabbath and Energy Saver. Operating at a quiet 41dB, it delivers reliable performance that blends seamlessly into your home.
